products.name: Westwood Sectional (Stone)
products.description: The Westwood Sectional combines style and comfort for modern living spaces. Upholstered in a warm stone fabric, this versatile sectional is designed to anchor any living room with a refined, contemporary look.

products.name: Westwood Sectional (Black)
products.description: Bold and style-conscious, the Westwood Sectional in Black brings an urban edge to any living space. Clean lines and deep cushioning make it a statement piece and an everyday comfort solution.

products.name: Westwood Sectional (Gunmetal)
products.description: The Westwood in Gunmetal blends style and functionality seamlessly. Its cool-toned upholstery pairs effortlessly with both neutral and bold interiors, making it an adaptable centerpiece for modern homes.

products.name: Westwood Sectional (Cream)
products.description: Light, airy, and contemporary — the Westwood Sectional in Cream brings warmth and elegance to any living room. Its neutral tone complements a wide range of decor styles, from minimalist to coastal.

products.name: Galaxy Power Sectional (Black)
products.description: Transform your home theater experience with the Galaxy Power Sectional. This black power reclining sectional features built-in USB charging ports, cup holders, and plush cushioning designed for maximum relaxation.

products.name: Sofa & Loveseat Set (Ivory)
products.description: A luxury faux fur sofa and loveseat set in ivory that adds softness and sophistication to your living room. The plush texture and warm ivory tone create an inviting, high-end aesthetic perfect for modern homes.

products.name: Sofa & Loveseat Set (Charcoal)
products.description: Luxurious faux fur upholstery in deep charcoal gives this sofa and loveseat set a bold yet cozy character. Designed for those who want dramatic style without compromising on everyday comfort.

products.name: Amalfi Sofa Collection (Champagne)
products.description: The Amalfi Collection in Champagne elevates your living space with a contemporary design that balances elegance and everyday comfort. Its warm champagne upholstery pairs beautifully with gold and neutral accents.

products.name: Amalfi Sofa Collection (Grey)
products.description: A contemporary grey fusion collection designed for modern homes. The Amalfi in Grey brings a clean, versatile look that works seamlessly with any color palette, offering both style and durability.

products.name: Lindon Track-Arm Sofa
products.description: The Lindon features a sleek contemporary track arm design paired with an armless loveseat and reversible cushions. Its clean silhouette and versatile configuration make it ideal for modern living rooms of any size.

products.name: Conlee-Pike Transitional Set
products.description: The Conlee-Pike transitional design set offers complete comfort with a classic aesthetic updated for modern sensibilities. Featuring generous cushioning and a warm fabric blend, it brings timeless elegance to your living room.

products.name: Joy II Sofa Collection (Grey)
products.description: Joy II in Grey merges glamour with modern function. Tufted details, elegant legs, and plush cushioning create a sophisticated focal point for any living room that values both beauty and comfort.

products.name: Joy II Sofa Collection (Beige)
products.description: The Joy II in Beige elevates your living space with glamorous tufting and a warm neutral tone. Designed for those who want a statement sofa that feels as good as it looks.

products.name: Joy II Sofa Collection (Black)
products.description: Sophisticated and functional, the Joy II in Black brings dramatic contrast and refined tufted detailing to your living space. A bold design choice that commands attention without sacrificing everyday comfort.

products.name: Star Modular Sofa (Light Grey)
products.description: The Star Collection in Light Grey offers unmatched flexibility with its modular design. Rearrange and reconfigure to suit any space or occasion — perfect for growing families and evolving interiors.

products.name: Star Modular Sofa (Dark Grey)
products.description: The Star in Dark Grey delivers a sophisticated, urban edge to any living room. Its modular design adapts to your lifestyle, while the deep grey tone anchors the space with confidence and style.

products.name: Star Modular Sofa (Black)
products.description: Elevate your living environment with the Star Modular Sofa in Black. Its bold color and flexible configuration make it a versatile choice for modern lofts, open-concept spaces, and family rooms alike.

products.name: Grace Reclining Set (Black)
products.description: The Grace Collection in Black corduroy features a power reclining sofa and loveseat with a convenient drop-down table and cup holders. Comfort and entertainment converge in this ultimate relaxation set.

products.name: Grace Reclining Set (Brown)
products.description: Warm brown corduroy upholstery meets powerful reclining mechanics in the Grace Collection. Complete with a drop-down table and storage console, this set is built for families who want comfort and functionality.

products.name: Ferland Cloud Sofa (Beige)
products.description: Sink into cloud-like comfort with the Ferland Collection in Beige. Oversized cushions, a low-profile silhouette, and ultra-soft upholstery combine to create the ultimate relaxation experience for your living room.

products.name: Austin Luscios Sofa (Black)
products.description: The Austin Luscios in Black chenille fabric delivers a luxurious feel at an accessible price. Its deep, rich tone and plush texture make it a standout piece for any modern or transitional living space.

products.name: Austin Ash Sofa
products.description: The Austin Ash Collection features premium chenille fabric in a warm ash tone, offering a perfect balance of comfort and contemporary style. Ideal for living rooms that want a relaxed yet polished aesthetic.

products.name: Acklen Place Wide Seat Recliner
products.description: The Acklen Place Wide Seat Power Recliner offers endless adaptability for your relaxation needs. With an extra-wide seat, smooth power recline, and supportive cushioning, it is built for full-body comfort and daily use.

products.name: Bleckley Power Reclining Loveseat
products.description: The Bleckley Power Reclining Loveseat with console combines luxurious relaxation features with practical storage. Dual power recline, a center console with cup holders, and USB charging make it a complete comfort station.

products.name: Nexus Power Reclining Loveseat (Dark Grey)
products.description: Designed for modern lounging, the Nexus Power Reclining Loveseat in Dark Grey offers smooth power recline and a streamlined contemporary look. Perfect for media rooms and open-plan living areas.

products.name: Nexus Power Reclining Loveseat (Light Grey)
products.description: The Nexus in Light Grey enhances your living space with a soft, neutral tone and reliable power reclining comfort. Dual recline, plush cushioning, and clean lines make it a versatile choice for any room.

products.name: Cassandra Bedroom Collection
products.description: The Cassandra Bedroom Collection is a masterpiece of contemporary design. Featuring a dramatic panel headboard, matching dresser, and nightstands with mirrored accents, it transforms your bedroom into a luxurious retreat.

products.name: Ivette Bedroom Collection (White)
products.description: Transform your bedroom into a serene sanctuary with the Ivette Collection in White. Clean lines, a platform bed with upholstered headboard, and matching storage pieces create a cohesive, spa-like atmosphere.

products.name: Gloria Smart Vanity Set
products.description: The Gloria Smart Vanity makes a bold statement with its hi-gloss black finish and integrated LED lighting. Featuring a Hollywood-style mirror, ample storage drawers, and a cushioned stool — your beauty routine elevated.

products.name: Ivette Smart Vanity Set
products.description: The luminous Ivette Smart Vanity redefines your beauty routine with integrated LED lighting, a Hollywood-style mirror, and elegant storage. A sophisticated addition to any bedroom or dressing room.

products.name: Destin Cove Pillow Top Mattress 16"
products.description: The Destin Cove Pillow Top 16" Queen Mattress features a tri-layer plush quilt construction that delivers pressure-relieving comfort for a restorative night sleep. Its extra-thick design cradles every curve for deep relaxation.

products.name: Destin Cove Plush Mattress 15"
products.description: Experience the perfect balance of softness and support with the Destin Cove Plush 15" Queen Mattress. Its tri-layer plush quilt foam construction provides a cloud-like sleep surface ideal for side and back sleepers.

products.name: Destin Cove Firm Mattress 14"
products.description: The Destin Cove Firm 14" Queen Mattress delivers consistent, full-body support through its tri-layer construction. Ideal for stomach and back sleepers who need firm, pressure-free support throughout the night.

products.name: 10" Memory Foam Mattress (Queen)
products.description: Our 10" Memory Foam Queen Mattress contours to your body for personalized comfort and pressure relief. High-density foam construction ensures lasting support and durability, night after night.

products.name: 12" Hybrid Mattress (King)
products.description: The 12" Hybrid King Mattress combines the pressure-relief of memory foam with the bounce and support of innerspring coils. Engineered for restorative rest, it is ideal for couples with different sleep preferences.

products.name: Hannodream Accent Table
products.description: The Hannodream makes a statement with its distinctive transitional silhouette. Featuring a tempered glass top and an ornate carved base, it brings sculptural beauty and practical surface space to any living room.

products.name: Camdill Chairside Table (Light Brown)
products.description: The Camdill Chairside End Table in Light Brown elevates your living room with modern features and warm wood tones. Perfectly sized to keep your essentials within reach, it is a stylish and practical addition to any seating area.

products.name: Camdill Chairside Table (Dark Brown)
products.description: The Camdill in Dark Brown brings sleek styling and rich tones to your living space. Its compact footprint and elevated design make it a versatile end table that works in both traditional and contemporary settings.

products.name: Camdill Chairside Table (Black)
products.description: Sleek, modern, and practical — the Camdill Chairside Table in Black complements any living space with its clean lines and matte finish. A perfect companion for sofas, recliners, and accent chairs.

products.name: Yomi Dining Chair (Beige/Walnut)
products.description: The Yomi Dining Chair in Beige faux leather with walnut legs brings organic warmth and contemporary sophistication to your dining space. Its ergonomic design ensures comfort during long meals and gatherings.

products.name: Yomi Dining Chair (Beige/Black)
products.description: Clean contrast meets refined design in the Yomi Dining Chair with beige faux leather upholstery and sleek black legs. A sophisticated choice for contemporary dining rooms that value both aesthetics and comfort.

products.name: Toni Dining Chair (Beige/Grey)
products.description: The Toni Dining Chair demonstrates sophisticated contrast with its beige upholstery and grey metal base. A transitional design that bridges classic and modern dining room aesthetics with effortless style.

products.name: Toni Dining Chair (Beige/Black)
products.description: Elegant and understated, the Toni Dining Chair in beige faux leather with a black frame is designed for those who appreciate refined simplicity. Sturdy construction and a cushioned seat make it as durable as it is beautiful.

products.name: Becky Dining Chair (Walnut)
products.description: The Becky Dining Chair in walnut and beige elevates your dining experience with natural warmth and timeless style. Its sculptural walnut legs and cushioned seat create the perfect combination of art and function.

products.name: Jorri Dining Set (White/Walnut)
products.description: The Jorri Dining Set blends organic walnut textures with a crisp white tabletop for a Scandinavian-inspired aesthetic. This complete set transforms your dining room into an inviting space for family meals and entertaining.

products.name: Valente Dining Collection (White/Walnut)
products.description: The Valente Dining Collection meets architectural precision standards with its white and walnut combination. Clean geometric lines, solid construction, and a timeless color palette make this a heirloom-quality dining set.

products.name: Roxy Sculptural Dining (White/Bronze)
products.description: The Roxy Sculptural Dining Collection in White and Bronze is a work of art for your dining room. Its dramatic bronze pedestal base and white marble-look tabletop create an unforgettable centerpiece for any gathering.

products.name: Roxy Sculptural Dining (Black/Bronze)
products.description: Drama and sophistication define the Roxy in Black and Bronze. This sculptural dining collection transforms any space with its bold aesthetic, making every meal feel like a luxury dining experience.
